qualify.descriptor.duplicate-symbol.en: Two ports of this plugin share the symbol {symbol}, so neither can be addressed by it; the plugin is not described.

qualify.compare.rt-not-reported.en: no process of the host reported (rt_watch.so was not loaded, or the host was gone)

qualify.compare.rt-no-callback.en: no process of the host set a JACK process callback that rt_watch.so could wrap

qualify.compare.rt-no-warm-up.en: the process callback never ran past its warm-up

qualify.compare.rt-trylocks-only.en: {trylocks} try-locks on the audio thread over {cycles} cycles; a try-lock never waits

qualify.compare.rt-unsafe.en: on the audio thread over {cycles} cycles: {allocations} allocations, {locks} locks, {syscalls} system calls

qualify.compare.no-port.en: no port of the plugin appeared on the graph

qualify.compare.no-audio-output.en: the plugin has no audio output

qualify.compare.output-not-finite.en: the output is not finite ({count} NaN or infinite samples)

qualify.compare.no-stimulus-silent.en: no stimulus this plugin takes (no audio or MIDI input), and its output was silent

qualify.compare.soak-host-ended.en: the host ended during the soak ({died})

qualify.compare.soak-ended.en: the host ended during the soak

qualify.compare.latency-port-observable.en: the host sets a JACK latency callback: the plugin's latency is on its output port's capture range

qualify.compare.latency-hostd-port-obser.en: its worker (omx-clap-host) sets a JACK latency callback

qualify.compare.latency-not-observable-m.en: mod-host sets no JACK latency callback, so a plugin's latency is not on its ports

qualify.compare.latency-unreadable.en: the output port's latency could not be read

qualify.pin.hostd-not-installed.en: plugin-hostd is not installed: the files of a pin are plugin-hostd's to name

qualify.pin.hostd-no-pin-files.en: this plugin-hostd has no --pin-files (plugin-hostd 0.15.0 or later names the files of a pin)

qualify.pin.hostd-no-root-or-file.en: plugin-hostd --pin-files printed no root or no file

qualify.pin.file-unreadable.en: a file plugin-hostd names cannot be read: {error}

qualify.cli.all-with-targets.en: --all and named plugins do not go together

qualify.cli.name-target.en: name a plugin (URI or .lv2 bundle) or pass --all

qualify.cli.two-grids.en: --grid-hosts and --grid name two grids; give one

qualify.cli.cells-budget.en: --cells-per-plugin-budget must be a whole number, 0 or more

qualify.cli.blocks.en: --blocks must be a whole number, 1 or more

qualify.adjust.options-only.en: {argument}: adjust takes options only; the records are read from --qualification-dir

qualify.adjust.now-seconds.en: --now must be UTC seconds, a whole number

qualify.compare.hosts-list-bad.en: --hosts takes a list of {hosts}; not a host: {bad}

qualify.compare.name-targets.en: name the plugins (LV2 URIs, bundles or .clap files) or --all

qualify.compare.publish-needs.en: --publish writes a summary for the records: it needs --out, --host-class and --set

qualify.compare.name-directory.en: name the directory of the comparison records

qualify.grid.part-unknown.en: the grid is hosts, full, or cells as <rate>/<quantum>, comma-separated; "{part}" is none of them

qualify.memory.limit-unread.en: the memory limit is off, or bytes as 2147483648, 2048M or 2G; "{value}" is neither

qualify.adapter.no-version.en: {tool} --version names no version, so a run could not say which host it was under

qualify.judge.name-probe-output.en: name at least one probe output

qualify.records.name-directory.en: name a qualification directory or a run root

qualify.records.package-word.en: {what} {value}: a package name holds lowercase letters, digits, + - and . only

qualify.records.cell-one-directory.en: --cell names the cell of one directory; name one

qualify.judged.no-verdict-format.en: no verdict under a host for {format}

qualify.judged.no-probe-version.en: the record names no plugin-hostd-probe version

qualify.judged.no-rules.en: the record states no rules, and no judgedBy was given

qualify.records.left-not-record.en: not a {schema} naming its probe output

qualify.records.left-other-cell.en: measured at {cells}, not at its set's {cell}

qualify.records.left-no-cell.en: measured at no cell, not at its set's {cell}

qualify.records.left-no-probe-output.en: its probe output {file} is not there

qualify.records.left-probe-output-other.en: its probe output {file} is not the copy it names

qualify.search-path.no-key.en: plugin-hostd --search-path printed no {key} with its source

qualify.search-path.no-effective.en: plugin-hostd --search-path printed no effective lv2 and clap lists

qualify.search-path.no-hostd.en: plugin-hostd is not installed: the directories scanned are the ones plugin-hostd searches

qualify.search-path.unsupported.en: this plugin-hostd has no --search-path (plugin-hostd 0.20.3 or later names the directories it searches)

qualify.search-path.from-env.en: {key} is plugin-hostd's environment ({variable}), not {where}: the running daemon may search other directories; write it in that file

qualify.search-path.from-env-own-file.en: {key} is plugin-hostd's environment ({variable}), not plugin-hostd's own settings file: the running daemon may search other directories; write it there

qualify.search-path.from-default.en: {key} is plugin-hostd's default, not {where}: the running daemon may search other directories; write it in that file

qualify.search-path.from-default-own-fil.en: {key} is plugin-hostd's default, not plugin-hostd's own settings file: the running daemon may search other directories; write it there

qualify.descriptor.origin-scanned.en: a scanned descriptor carries origin scanned

qualify.judged.files-pin.en: --files must be the 64 hex digits of the files pin
